name: Elemental
body:
Elemental Creature (CR +1)

An elemental creature is a native of an elemental plane. Each elemental creature has the elemental sorcerer bloodline as an associated bloodline, and selects one of the four elements for that bloodline.

An elemental creature’s quick and rebuild rules are the same.

Rebuild Rules: Type gains the extraplanar subtype and the subtype matching the element selected for its associated bloodline; Speed gains the elemental movement bloodline power of its associated bloodline; Immune gains the elemental body bloodline power of its associated bloodline; Weaknesses gains vulnerability to cold if it has the fire subtype; Melee adds 1 point of damage of the energy type matching its associated bloodline to the damage dealt by each of its natural weapon attacks.
